variant.title: Beacon Sudoku
variant.description: Each entry sends a short reveal pulse; correct entries reveal an additional nearby square.
rule_guide.title: Beacon Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Some empty cells start hidden behind a mask.
rule_guide.item_3: Every placed digit reveals a cross up to two cells away.
rule_guide.item_4: A correct placed digit also reveals the surrounding 3x3 square. Revealed cells stay visible until restart.
